followup_explanation:
I routed to Dunlin-235B because this is a well-specified math problem with a single correct answer, and accuracy is what matters here.

Dunlin has stronger scores across the relevant benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 56.2, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.3, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2). For a quantitative reasoning task where the user explicitly cares about getting the correct answer with clean work, those higher reasoning and instruction-following benchmarks point to Dunlin as the better fit.

Willet's documented task preference would actually favor a well-specified problem like this, but preference is dissociated from capability per the docs — and on raw capability, Dunlin is the stronger model here.
